name: x717tp-verification-baseline
goal: Prove the clean-main CI video and workspace audit failures, repair their causes without weakening recording authorization or audit limits, and pass normal full verification.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Clean current main e17f3b49b6 reproduces six capture authorization failures under CI=1. Current direct app audits report Reports 287, Desktop 243, Hub 71, Planning 6, Collaboration 27, Remote 7, Relay 1, Game 0. Prior clean-main MB2 captures document the 60s planner timeout.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing clip planning case checks readFileSync deduplication; extend it to check duplicate statSync validation inside an immutable plan. Existing capture cases exercise real behavior behind a host-specific authorization gate and synthetic cases currently inherit process CI.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness recorded failing checkpoint 29a5b34c38. The unchanged CI=1 planner case reports 36 stat calls for nine distinct paths. Clean-current-main MB2 comparison independently confirms the reported 60-second timeout.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The planner caches successfully validated bindings within one plan. Positive synthetic capture cases isolate authorization, and true authorization denial remains independently tested.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same committed regression failed at 29a5b34c38 and passed unchanged at cd58e8ceb0 under matched runner environment. MB2 integrated focused runs also passed.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
